notes.title: 1.5.0 Dark Path: Evil Cards, New Weapons, Wave 80 Zombies & More!
notes.content:
Welcome to Update 1.5.0: Dark Path! Brace yourself as the battle intensifies with the addition of powerful Evil Cards, brand-new weapons, and a chilling Wave 80 zombie onslaught. Dive into the Halloween spirit with exclusive costumes, and prepare for more surprises as you take on the undead like never before!

Evil Card

Introducing the new "Evil Card" upgrade! Each offers unique, powerful boosts that come with their own risks. Now featuring 5 evil cards: Tornado, Echo, Fury, Hunger, Pride. Will you dare to wield them?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/559f5bf11488a0171526aef376d816c013d21eff.png

New Halloween Styles

6 New Faces: Shocking Eyes, Cat Eyes, Crazy Eyes, Mad Doctor Face, Smiling Eyes, Multiple Eyes.
4 New Hats:  Skull Hat, Pumpkin Hat, Grave Hat, Candy Hat.
2 New Skins: Pale Brown, Mint.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/26622aaba344cf6ae74c2cc4caec708996d0eb20.png

Shark Boss zombie The King of the Sea!. Armed with a powerful trident and capable of unleashing water spells,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/b8e16f22348ec239531178a2db807b62d0292748.gif

Added a new option: Shop, where you can use "Green Balls" as currency. Green Balls have a chance to be dropped by zombies!

Blink Musket Teleport to where your bullet shot at.
Blade Wheel Place a spinning blade wheel trap.
Glue Place a large sticky liquid on the floor.
Spike Pendulum Place a swinging spike ball pendulum.
Explosive Bolt Shoot high velocity bolt which attached with time-bomb.

Pen Throw out a very special pen (?). 
Shock Gun Stun all zombies in front for few seconds.
Health Elixir Instantly heals for huge amount.
Shield Elixir Instantly gives you full amount of shield/armor.
Pocket Loot Instantly gives you a random weapon, just like a loot box—but with the advantage of being usable anytime!
 Bring these weapons into shop item: Laser Gun, Machine Gun, Rocket Launcher.
 Bring these super cards into new shop item weapon: Charge Cannon, Red Laser Gun, Laser Machine Gun.

notes.title: 1.4.0 Biggest update ever! New experience, upgrades and new map: Highway.
notes.content:
Biggest update ever – Zombie Uprising: Experience Evolution!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/f1da8777414c0eb6a136dbda8ca97b16c4bfc6a0.png
Hello survivors!

It's been an incredible year since "Around Us: Zombie Shooter" launched in Early Access. We have some thrilling news to share!

$ Price Update
First, a heads-up: with this update, at version 1.4.0, the game's price will increase from $2.99 to $4.99.

Major Update: Version 1.4.0
We're excited to announce that our next big update, version 1.4.0, is now released.

[previewyoutube=gw5rLt3xves;full][/previewyoutube]
Let's see list of the update.

1. Challenge System

 Old System: Easy/Normal/Hard had all waves, with harder difficulties featuring higher damage/health multipliers.
New Challenges: Each map now features various challenges, such as double health, boss rush, one-hit kills, etc.
Unlocking Challenges: Each challenge require different number of badges (badge = number of challenges won) to unlock, default challenges which doesn't require any badge are Easy, Normal and Hard.
Rewards: Winning challenges grants rewards and world records.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/f9889d6c45e3f3cb9adc2bee9c84d0cf2504bc22.jpg

2. New Map: Highway

Highway The fourth map of the game, Zombies can appoarches mainly two ways.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/f929c5def526043c4b56e7e1582e7db6dd4c6476.png

3. New Zombies

Armored Jumper Can jump and stomp to you, just like jumper, but a lot stronger.
Stone zombie Very tough zombie, has high resistance to almost everything.
Spike zombie Has spike skin. Better not to contact them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/75895483c44b8c73944fd2484cc051033fac0b63.png

4. New Boss: Crystal Boss

Wave 70: A new boss, the Crystal Boss, will appear at wave 70.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/b42491cdaa41a7230e314afd7518857daf2a138a.jpg

5. Perk Tree System

Perk Books: Players can now gain "Perk Books" through rewards or loot boxes to upgrade unique passive abilities in the perk tree. Now with 12 first perks.
First 12 Perks Critical Strke, Fast Learner, Spike Bat, Metal Bat, Safety Helmet, It's ok if no luck, Lucky One, Start Pack, Atleast A Pistol, Ghost Energy, Meaningful Death, Baby With A Gun.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/eb6080277696a1bbb96a3101a87da963266164a0.png

Big heart: +50 max HP.

notes.title: Wave 40! A lot of new changes!?
notes.content:
Hi, Zombie shooters! Currently the game has wave limit of 30, and yet no one seems to able to reach that wave. In this update we expand the limit to 40! Wave 10-30 will be rebalanced with new zombies and new spawn patterns. You would experience the change of gameplay, let's take a look to details.

1. Major change, faster gameplay

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/1db37a997c5be6e50229e40e5a5d0a7d1f57acd0.png

- Now zombies will spawn after 5-15 seconds after wave end (instead of wait untill all zombies killed)
- Now only wait for all zombies to be killed to end wave every 10 waves.
- Now only spawn all dead players every 10 waves.
- Upgrade card selection is now appear when the score is reached, instead of every wave end.
- Incease more variety of waves by adding 10 more spawn patterns.
- Zombie variation are now increased slower by waves than previous version.
- Reduce amount of zombie each wave.
- Easy mode now reduce amount zombie by 25%, Reduce zombie HP by 50% instead of 25%

2. New zombie
These are new zombies in this patch, you'll see them more on wave 30+, but as we tested, it very hard to get to that high level.
- Jumper: Can jump toward player and cause landing damage.
- Thief: Can steal player's items.
- Spider: Can release spider web to slow player.
- Insect: Create acid pool when dead.
- Miner: Attack player's traps.
- Rhino (Boss): Very big zombie, can charge and hit you.

3. New mechanic on player respawn
We observed that when playing multiplayer, dead player are just sitting and wait for minutes to respawn. So we decide to make a change.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/9395b0a15b5efa8ca575e42150384bf0277db344.png

- Now dead player will become ghost, ghosts need to find a revive statue which will has a chance to appear every 10 seconds and has cooldown of 15-120 seconds.
- Ghosts can't attack of equip weapons and move very slow.
- All players still has free respawn at the end of wave 1,5,10,15,20,25,30,40.

4. New contents
- Add new card: Duo pistol
- Shotgun card: "More spread bullet" max level increased from 1 to 2

5. Improvements
- Now tower level 1,2,3 are different.
- Change join method from room list to join using room code.
- Add game intro.
- 40+ new steam achievements
- Now gun image, bullet count and hp bar sizes are increased by 200%

4. Bug fixes & rebalance
- Make these zombies weaker: Normal, digger, bomber, big, hybrid zombies.
- Reduce speed increase per card level from 12% to 10%.
- Now player only get 50% damage from own bombs.
- Increase fire damage per tick from 16 to 17.
- Player now can't get damage in first 3 second after spawned.
- Fix mouse cursor disappear when leave room.
- Fix bug zombie can attack dead players.
- Fix bomb graphic not shown on remote players.
- Fix player still get score from dead zombies after wave ended.
- Fix bug start game more than once.
- Fix barrel won't respawn when play new match

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Info you need for Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi there! Early Access release is approaching this July, 19. Surely, surviving in zombie waves won't be easy. So we'd like to prepare you guys for the launch. These are the information about Around Us : Zombie Shooter v.1.2. (Initial version of Early access release)

HOW TO PLAY
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/47883d2d5f3a205e84c466936cb0f1fc1a5ecb05.jpg

 Keyboard is supported. (Maximum of 2 players).
 GamePad/JoyStick/Controller is supported.

PLAY MODE
 2 Playable mode :
          1. Local - Shared screen. Playable upto 6 local players (Can play maximum with 2 keyboards and 4 controllers).
          2. Online - This is room based game. Host can set amount of players per connection. So, for each connection from a computer can connect upto 4 local players.

WAVES
 1 Available map : Classic
 3 Difficulty levels : Easy, Normal, Hard
 Maximum of 30 waves

ZOMBIES
 Normal zombie - just a zombie.
 Quick zombie - quick, as its name.
 Big zombie - more health, but slow.
 Baby zombie - very fast, but weak.
 Digger zombie - can dig and jump to you.
 Invisible zombie - very hard to see.
 Mummy zombie - higher resistance zombie.
 Armored zombie - zombie which iron skin, can block bullets.
 Quick armored zombie - like armored zombie, but faster.
 Shield zombie - can't get shoot in front.
 Ghost zombie - can pass through most things.
 Bomber zombie - explode when close to you.
 Huge zombie (Boss-tier) - very strong and slow.
 Thrower zombie (Boss-tier) - can throw stones.
 Hybrid zombie (Boss-tier) - can release poisonous explosive spores.

WEAPONS
 Pistol - infinite ammo, basic gun.
 Assault Rifle - shoot very fast.
 Shotgun - spread bullets.
 Spike Trap - a trap, hurt zombies.
 Bomb - grenade, BOOM!
 Landmine - explode when stepped on it.
 Sniper Rifle - shoot very far, can scope.
 Framethrower - release pile of frame.
 Rocket Launcher - shoot our rocket!
 Electric Trap - a trap, shock and paralyze zombies.
 Machinegun - shoot very fast and spreading bullets.
 Lasergun - can pierce through most fresh!

UPGRADES
 40+ Rogue-like upgrade cards.
 Roulette upgrade system.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/21edb0968fba603097919aa23d5f2dc92c5cae95.jpg

HELPERS
 Rune system.
 Heart tower.

CUSTOMIZATION
10 Color customization.
10 Face customization.

OTHERS
 Emotion system.

You would expect to see issues during Early Access but we are actively developing the game. So, feel free to talk with us. We're openning for you.

As we progress through development, we aim to introducing new zombie waves where the player can explore new items, enemies, maps and mechanics of gameplay.

By full version of the game, we aim to provide multiple ways of playing multiplayer (local + online). The game will be playable upto 100+ waves which is not just repeat of waves. Player can have fancy costumes, characters and abilities.

Around Us is still on the way to go. Hope you enjoy the game.

Good luck,
SCF-Aon

notes.title: Free demo is now released!
notes.content:
Hello world! We are happy to announce our release of Around Us demo version.
You can play it for free!

In this DEMO include the following features:


 Shared screen multiplayer (local co-op) up to 4 players.
 Keyboard is supported. (Maximum of 2 players).
 GamePad/JoyStick/Controller is supported.
 Maximum of 10 waves.
 12 Unlockables.
 40 Avaiable upgrade cards.
 6 Zombie types.
 2 Bosses.
 Color customization.
 Normal difficulty.


If you like the demo, be sure to add Around Us to your wishlist.
